CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_INDIVIDUALCUSTOMER_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer AS 
(
     SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_LOCAL_NAME AS IndividualCustomerName
    ,BCD.CUST_DTE_BIRTH AS DateOfBirth
    ,BCD.CUST_SEX AS SexId
    ,BCD.CUST_SEX AS GenderId
    ,BCD.CUST_BIRTH_PLACE AS BirthPlaceCity
    ,BCD.CUST_MOM_NAME AS MothersMaidenName
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS Dosri
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS DosriTypeId
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
UNION 

SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_LOCAL_NAME AS IndividualCustomerName
    ,BCD.CUST_DTE_BIRTH AS DateOfBirth
    ,BCD.CUST_SEX AS SexId
    ,BCD.CUST_SEX AS GenderId
    ,BCD.CUST_BIRTH_PLACE AS BirthPlaceCity
    ,BCD.CUST_MOM_NAME AS MothersMaidenName
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS Dosri
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS DosriTypeId
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,BCD.CUST_RELATION AS RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer FROM TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,IndividualCustomerName
,DateOfBirth
,SexId
,GenderId
,BirthPlaceCity
,MothersMaidenName
,Dosri
,DosriTypeId
,RelatedPartyIndicator
,RelatedPartyTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,IndividualCustomerName
,DateOfBirth
,SexId
,GenderId
,BirthPlaceCity
,MothersMaidenName
,Dosri
,DosriTypeId
,RelatedPartyIndicator
,RelatedPartyTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CCD'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
     IndividualCustomerName = SRC.IndividualCustomerName
    ,DateOfBirth = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.DateOfBirth))
    ,DateOfDeath = NULL
    ,SexId = SRC.SexId
    ,GenderId = SRC.GenderId
    ,EthnicCategoryId = NULL
    ,RacialCategoryId = NULL
    ,PreferredName = NULL
    ,ShortName = NULL
    ,NameSuffix = NULL
    ,BirthPlaceCountry = NULL
    ,BirthPlaceCity = SRC.BirthPlaceCity
    ,NonResidentIndicator = NULL
    ,MothersMaidenName = SRC.MothersMaidenName
    ,EmployeeIndicator = NULL
    ,Dosri = SRC.Dosri
    ,DosriTypeId = SRC.DosriTypeId
    ,MinorIndicator = NULL
    ,Segment = NULL
    ,RelatedPartyIndicator = SRC.RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,RelatedPartyTypeId = SRC.RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,FATCAIndicator = NULL
    ,FATCATypeId = NULL
FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.IndividualCustomer
(
     CustomerId
    ,IndividualCustomerName
    ,DateOfBirth
    ,DateOfDeath
    ,SexId
    ,GenderId
    ,EthnicCategoryId
    ,RacialCategoryId
    ,PreferredName
    ,ShortName
    ,NameSuffix
    ,BirthPlaceCountry
    ,BirthPlaceCity
    ,NonResidentIndicator
    ,MothersMaidenName
    ,EmployeeIndicator
    ,Dosri
    ,DosriTypeId
    ,MinorIndicator
    ,Segment
    ,RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,FATCAIndicator
    ,FATCATypeId
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
     CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,IndividualCustomerName AS IndividualCustomerName
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,DateOfBirth)) AS DateOfBirth
    ,NULL AS DateOfDeath
    ,SexId AS SexId
    ,GenderId AS GenderId
    ,NULL AS EthnicCategoryId
    ,NULL AS RacialCategoryId
    ,NULL AS PreferredName
    ,NULL AS ShortName
    ,NULL AS NameSuffix
    ,NULL AS BirthPlaceCountry
    ,BirthPlaceCity AS BirthPlaceCity
    ,NULL AS NonResidentIndicator
    ,MothersMaidenName AS MothersMaidenName
    ,NULL AS EmployeeIndicator
    ,Dosri AS Dosri
    ,DosriTypeId AS DosriTypeId
    ,NULL AS MinorIndicator
    ,NULL AS Segment
    ,RelatedPartyIndicator AS RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,RelatedPartyTypeId AS RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,NULL AS FATCAIndicator
    ,NULL AS FATCATypeId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA;

END
